title: 법무자문위원회규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Subcommittees)
(1) The Committee may establish subcommittees to deliberate efficiently on the matters specified in the subparagraphs of Article 3. <Amended on February 3, 2022.>
(2) A separate special subcommittee consisting of no more than 130 persons may be established to investigate and research matters in a specific field deemed temporarily necessary by the Minister of Justice and provide advice thereon. Its period of existence shall not exceed one year and may be extended only once. <Amended on September 4, 1975; August 31, 1985; December 14, 1989; November 9, 2004; and August 6, 2007.>
(3) Each subcommittee (including a special subcommittee; hereinafter the same shall apply) shall have one chairperson commissioned by the Minister of Justice from among its members. <Amended on September 4, 1975.>
(4) Each subcommittee shall investigate and research matters within its jurisdiction among the matters specified in Article 3 and matters specifically commissioned to it by the Committee, and shall report or make recommendations to the Chairperson.
